program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_3 = rightmost(true, true)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & !is_a@j | !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_c@j, !is_bos@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & h1_3@j | !is_bos@j & !is_a@j, !is_b@j | !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & is_c@j)
accept = !is_c & !h2_2 | h2_1 & !h2_2

output accept
